## What WEALTH Is

Capital intelligence organ of the arifOS federation. Deductive math (NPV/IRR/EMV),
institutional diagnostics, market signals, and sovereign pulse compute
(PETRONAS·φ VITALS). Outputs are envelopes with epistemic tags — not trade tickets.

## Markets Surface (2026-10-14)

Paired observation terminals with provenance, freshness states and machine endpoints.
Shared contract with arif-fazil.com World Economics:

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `/api/markets/registry` | Machine-readable market registry (paired World↔WEALTH routes, states) |
| `/markets/` | Hub — all terminals + reported watchlist |
| `/markets/{gold,oil,gas,klci,usdmyr}/` | Per-market observation terminal (HTML) |
| `/markets/{id}/index.md` | Same content, markdown lane for agents |
| `/api/markets/{id}/latest` | Latest observation JSON — value, as_of, source, evidence class |

**Honesty states** (baked at generation time): `FRESH` (as_of ≤ 48h) · `STALE` (older) ·
`UNKNOWN` (no observation wired — never fabricated) · `UNAVAILABLE` (generation-time
fetch failed — retry, do not cache). Broker-reported levels are labeled REPORTED —
they are never WEALTH forecasts and never trade signals.

## Economic Context (World pairing)

- [World Economics hub](https://arif-fazil.com/world/economics/): human narrative, Malaysia
  and geopolitical context. WEALTH terminals pair 1:1 with World routes
  (`/world/economics/gold|oil|gas|klci|usdmyr/` ↔ `/markets/{id}/`).
- Honest status (2026-10-14, F13 SABAR / Option B): the World static terminal lane is
  **sealed** (`index.html.bak-reseal`); instrument deep links serve a generic SPA shell.
  Linking is **fail-closed**: this surface links only to the verified World hub. The
  registry separates `world.desired_url` (deep route) from `world_url` / `world.verified_url`
  (hub), with `surface_status: SEALED` and `link_policy: HUB_FALLBACK`. Reversal is a
  separate ticket: WORLD-TERMINAL-REVERSAL-001 (witness old seal intent, clean tree,
  canary terminal first, F13 acceptance before any five-terminal rollout).
- arifOS governance judgment: https://arifos.arif-fazil.com

## Public MCP Tools (15)

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `capital_primitive` | NPV, IRR, EMV, EVOI, Monte Carlo, Kelly, Markowitz, robust / chance-constrained |
| `capital_health` | Conservation, flow, runway, survival, fiscal breakeven |
| `capital_diagnose` | Institutional stress, governance, cascade, collapse, power, **petronas_vitals** |
| `capital_market` | FX, commodities, indicators, stocks |
| `capital_indicator` | Pure indicator computation: EMA, SMA, RSI, MACD, BB, PSAR, ATR, ADX |
| `capital_backtest` | XAUUSD strategy backtest (EMA + ATR stops + RSI pullback + S/R fusion) |
| `capital_entry_plan` | S/R-aware entry zone, stop loss, take-profit targets (COMPUTE_ONLY) |
| `capital_ledger` | Query; write is C2/IRREVERSIBLE (human ack) |
| `capital_registry` | Live status, schema, domains, health |
| `capital_claims` | Named-entity claim gate — OBS_ELIGIBLE needs external source + timestamp |
| `capital_entropy` | Entropy / integrity modes (may report UNAVAILABLE) |
| `capital_polix` | Power topology, capture detection, rent extraction, rule asymmetry |
| `capital_civx` | Civilizational scenario intelligence — resilience, sovereignty, burden |
| `wealth_synthesize` | Ω00 cross-dimensional synthesis over the 12 Ω-invariants |
| `wealth_judge_handoff` | Prepare or submit a structured arifOS governance handoff |

`capital_wisdom` and former institutional compatibility names are internal or
historical references only; they are absent from public `tools/list`.

### Key diagnose modes (examples)

```
capital_diagnose  mode=petronas_vitals     → PETRONAS·φ distance-to-trip pulse (COMPUTE_ONLY)
capital_diagnose  mode=stress_index        → institutional stress 0–1
capital_diagnose  mode=governance_capacity → board/governance capacity
capital_diagnose  mode=collapse_signature  → collapse corpus scan
```

Payload may override tripwires/weights for petronas_vitals; defaults are F2-aligned FY2025 IFR.

---

## Boundaries (hard)

- NEVER authorize capital allocation or move money
- NEVER claim buy/sell/hold as an order
- NEVER fabricate market data — cite source + timestamp or UNKNOWN
- NEVER bypass arifOS constitutional governance
- NEVER claim ledger write persisted without confirmation
- PETRONAS·φ is a **sense organ** — distance-to-trip only, not a trade signal

## Epistemic Tags

Outputs carry OBSERVED / DERIVED / INTERPRETED / SPECULATED / ASSUMED style tags via WealthEnvelope.
Composite institutional pulses inherit the **weaker** tag when mix EVIDENCE + INTERPRET.
